|events=[[Blue Star Centre]] is founded {{Circa}}<ref name="Date">The adventure "[[Operation Blue Star]]" of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] campaign establishes [[Blue Star Centre]] to have been founded 103 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior. The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' dates the beginning of the campaign to one year after the events of {{Film|I}}, which translates to around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', while "[[Below the Belt: Philology]]" shifts the setting of the campaign ten years forward, that is, to around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. '''134 BBY''' or '''134<ref name="Date" /> Before the Battle of Yavin''' was a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] in the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]]<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> that was a part of the era known as the [[Great Peace of the Republic]].<ref name="Era" /> Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Blue Star Centre]]&mdash;home to a group of [[Philosopher/Legends|philosophers]]&mdash;was founded in the [[City/Legends|settlement]] [[Gadrin]] on<ref name="OBS">{{LivingForce|Operation Blue Star}}</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].<ref name="OBS" />

==Behind the scenes==
134 BBY was indirectly mentioned in the "[[Operation Blue Star]]" adventure of [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] campaign,<ref name="OBS" /> released in [[2001]]<ref name="Release Date">{{Wizards|url=rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf20011115a3_release&c=swlfc|text="Law and Order" scenario schedule for September 2001 - December 2001}}</ref> and written by [[Megan Robertson]].<ref name="OBS" />
